content:
Exciting opportunity for PhD students passionate about Lean, Automated Reasoning, and AI! AWS is offering 2025 internships to work on cutting-edge LEAN projects. To learn about projects using Lean at AWS, read How the Lean language brings math to coding and coding to math written by @Leonardo de Moura .

To apply:

  1. Apply using this link: https://www.amazon.jobs/en/jobs/2793769/2025-applied-science-internship-automated-reasoning-united-states-phd-student-science-recruiting?no_int_redir=1
  2. DM me after applying for expedited processing.
